title: The Cap by DynaVap
description:
The Cap by DynaVap is a big part of what makes DynaVap so special. The cap is made out of medical grade stainless steel and is engineered to click 1-2 times once it reaches the correct temperature. This is achieved by heating the cap with a torch lighter.
The cap is also designed to be a very handy tool. With its main job being scooping out spent herb. But is also handy for other tasks as well. Pretty sure Macgyver played a part in the design of this handy little cap.
Included
1 x The Cap
